canonical_project: PMICE fiber endpoint - Iriba transmission site (Wadi Fira)
owner: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: Iriba (Wadi Fira) is the eastern endpoint of the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh 20 Dec 2025; the 2020 PMICE route plan also includes Am Zoer, Guereda and Iriba in Wadi Fira. Final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/fiber site, NOT commercial DC.
